sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-Escha-W2 — hipfire builds EschaLabs' Escha-W22-bit trellis quantization of Qwen3.8-27B, packaged for hipfireon AMD RDNA3/RDNA4. The trellis codes are stored verbatim and decoded inside the GEMV— there is no decode-at-load step and no re-quantisation of the coded projections.
